evidence: The wires were characterized physically, and complemented by electrical measurements. Cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images of the wires, across and along the wires, together with elemental mapping are shown in Fig. 2. Elemental mapping using electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) confirm the homogeneous distribution of Ru in wires and also the presence of Ti in the adhesion layer. Resistances were measured on the wires with lengths of 7, 47, 97, 485, and 1455 µm. The resistivity and the electrical cross-section area were deduced from temperature-dependent electrical measurements.
